core_connection.text: Mia is a Spotify Premium subscriber who writes to Spotify Support to dispute billing charges and ask for refunds.

evidence.quote: Could you please refund the $5.00 difference

facts.text: On March 30, 2025, Mia changed her plan from Premium Family to Premium Individual.

evidence.quote: I changed my plan to Premium Individual on March 30, 2025

facts.text: On April 8, 2025, Mia was still charged the Family price of $16.99.

evidence.quote: I was charged $16.99 for Premium Family on April 8, 2025

facts.text: Mia asked for the $5.00 difference to be refunded as a one-time exception. She argued the April 8 charge should have been at the Individual price.

evidence.quote: The April 8 charge should therefore have been at the Individual price.

facts.text: Mia cancelled her Premium Individual plan on February 20, 2026. Her account page showed Premium would end on March 7, 2026.

evidence.quote: I cancelled my Premium Individual plan on February 20, 2026

facts.text: Mia was still charged $11.99 on March 8, 2026, and Premium showed as active again on her account.

evidence.quote: On March 8, 2026 I was still charged $11.99

facts.text: Mia says she did not restart Premium herself and has not played anything on the account since March 7, 2026. She asked which device restarted it.

evidence.quote: I did not restart Premium on March 8, 2026
I have not played anything on the account since March 7
check which device restarted the subscription

facts.text: When first-level support turns down a request, Mia asks for it to be escalated to the billing team.

evidence.quote: please escalate the request to the billing team
please escalate the request to the billing team
